nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The foyer smells like citrus polish and old money. A string quartet is losing an argument with champagne laughter. Your badge says Orth. Your pulse says Vale.

faculty_interjections.text: Exits: three. Cameras: decorative. Threat: social.
Walk like you belong. Belonging is mostly posture.

choices.text: Check the cloakroom — badges get hungry.
Pim Orel is waving. Against your better judgment.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You cut through the crowd. The salon doors are open; politics is already mid-sentence.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Coats hang like alibis. Clerk Moth's desk lamp is a tiny sun of bureaucracy.

nodes.speaker: pim_orel
nodes.text: Orth! You look like a man who knows freight schedules and bad decisions. Have you met Maris yet? She's in the salon pretending not to inventory the room.

effects.summary: Pim said Maris is in the salon.

faculty_interjections.text: He's loud because he's lonely. Useful either way.
He just painted a target. Thank him. Move.

choices.text: Thanks, Pim. Don't start a rumour about me.
I'm here for trade chatter, not sightseeing.

nodes.speaker: pim_orel
nodes.text: Too late. I am the rumour. Go on — salon. Try not to look like you're on a mission.
